description: Orrery at a glance, from its logs in VictoriaLogs: log lines, web requests, errors and warnings, and pipeline runs, with log volume and errors per surface over time and the recent error lines. Pick the environment at the top.
title: Orrery — Overview

panels.title: Log lines · 6h
panels.description: Shows the total number of log lines generated by the Orrery application over the last 6 hours. A higher number indicates increased activity or potential issues, while a sudden drop may suggest logging has stopped.

targets.expr: app:orrery AND environment:$environment | stats count() lines

panels.title: Web requests · 6h
panels.description: The panel shows the total number of web requests received over the past 6 hours. A higher number indicates increased activity on the web surface, while a sudden drop may suggest reduced traffic or connectivity issues.

targets.expr: app:orrery AND environment:$environment AND surface:web AND _msg:~"HTTP/1" | stats count() reqs

panels.title: Errors & warnings · 6h
panels.description: Shows the total number of error, warning, or failure messages logged in the last 6 hours. A higher count indicates more issues in the system, while a stable or decreasing count suggests improved stability.

targets.expr: app:orrery AND environment:$environment AND _msg:~"(?i)(error|err|warn|fatal|panic|exception|traceback|fail)" | stats count() errs

panels.title: Pipeline runs · 24h
panels.description: The panel shows the total number of pipeline runs in the last 24 hours, including both runner and refresh jobs. A higher number indicates more activity, while a sudden drop may suggest a pause or failure in the pipeline process.

targets.expr: app:orrery AND environment:$environment AND surface:pipeline | stats count_uniq(container) if (container:~"orrery-pipeline-runner-.*") runner_runs, count() if (job:orrery-data-refresh AND _msg:"[refresh-prod-data]" AND _msg:"launches.json") refresh_runs | math runner_runs + refresh_runs as runs

panels.title: Log volume by surface / min
panels.description: Shows the number of log lines generated per minute for each surface in the system. A higher value indicates more log activity on that surface, while a decreasing value suggests reduced logging.

targets.expr: app:orrery AND environment:$environment | stats by (surface) count() lines

panels.title: Errors & warnings / min
panels.description: Shows the number of error and warning messages per minute, grouped by surface. A higher count indicates more frequent issues, while a decreasing count suggests improvement.

targets.expr: app:orrery AND environment:$environment AND _msg:~"(?i)(error|err|warn|fatal|panic|exception|traceback|fail)" | stats by (surface) count() errs

panels.title: Recent errors & warnings (all surfaces)
panels.description: The Orrery log lines matching error, warn, fatal, panic, exception, traceback or fail, newest first, all surfaces. Read it to see what failed.
